title: Payment tracking
banner: {{brand}} TRACKS the payment, it never triggers one: no transfer order leaves this screen, and no bank details are ever stored. What you prepare and approve here is the tracking; the transfer happens in your bank.
columnsPinned: The consultant stays visible: without them, a payment row names nobody.
remindAllHint: Records a chase on the overdue payments shown. Nothing is sent — you write it yourself.
remindNothing: No overdue payment to chase this month.
financeHidden: Amounts are hidden: your role doesn’t grant access to financial data. Counts stay readable.
withoutScheduledDate_one: {{count}} approved with no scheduled payment date
withoutScheduledDate_other: {{count}} approved with no scheduled payment date
noDeltaReason: no snapshot of the previous month was taken: a variation cannot be computed without a point of comparison
empty: No payment to track this month.
emptyWhy: A row appears here as soon as a mission has an assignment for the month. If you see none, the month you picked covers no active mission.
emptyFilteredWhy: The month holds others — drop a filter to see them again.

cession.missingReason: no assignment was prepared for this client on this month
cession.rejected: Assignment turned down by the factor
cession.recalled: Assignment taken back by the factor

actions.wait: Nothing to do before the scheduled date

noValidation: the timesheet was not approved by the client — that approval is what authorises the payment
noAmount: no subcontractor invoice prices this payment yet
noScheduledDate: no scheduled payment date was entered — no delay can be computed
unknownConsultant: no readable assignment for this month
unknownAccount: the mission is not attached to any readable account
rejectHint: A reason is mandatory: “rejected” with nothing else cannot be read back six months later, and the consultant who asks why deserves better than a status.
rejectPlaceholder: Duplicate invoice, wrong amount, mission not covered…
nothingIsSent: No transfer leaves {{brand}}, and no chase either: what is recorded here is what you did elsewhere.

toasts.generated: Payment prepared — it now awaits your approval.
toasts.generateFailed: The payment could not be prepared.
toasts.validated: Payment approved. The transfer happens in your bank: {{brand}} triggers none.
toasts.validateFailed: The payment could not be approved.
toasts.settleFailed: The payment could not be recorded.
toasts.rejectFailed: The rejection could not be recorded.
toasts.remindedPartial_one: {{count}} chase recorded, {{skipped}} skipped (already paid or rejected).
toasts.remindedPartial_other: {{count}} chases recorded, {{skipped}} skipped (already paid or rejected).
toasts.remindFailed: The chases could not be recorded.
toasts.exportFailed: The export could not be produced.
